hearing.matter: Breach of Contract and Intellectual Property Infringement regarding 'Project Helios' proprietary software architecture.
hearing.instructions: The recipient is required to present themselves in person at the designated time and room. Please bring valid photographic identification and any original documentation relevant to the software development logs mentioned in the subpoena. You may be required to provide sworn testimony under oath.
hearing.failure_consequences: Failure to comply with this summons without lawful excuse may result in a warrant being issued for your arrest and may subject you to a finding of contempt of court, punishable by fine or imprisonment.
